meta.title: Veritas Tasks — tasks that glow
meta.description: A planner where tasks become stars, projects become planets and shared goals with friends become constellations. Works offline, on phone and desktop.

home.eyebrow: A planner from the next orbit
home.title: Every task is a star.
home.lead: Tasks, habits and projects turn into constellations. Share goals with friends, earn experience and watch your galaxy grow.

errors.notFoundText: This page is not on our star map. The link may be outdated or the address may contain a typo.
errors.errorText: We have logged the error. Please try again — that usually helps.

toast.undoIn: You can undo for {seconds} more s

design.title: “Orbit” design system
design.lead: Every token, component and state of Veritas Tasks on a single page. Visible in development mode only.

typeSamples.body: Tasks, habits and projects turn into constellations. Every action responds instantly — even without internet.
typeSamples.bulgarian: Всяка задача е звезда. Подреди своето небе и ѝ дай светлина.
typeSamples.pangram: Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.

inputs.title: Title
inputs.hint: You can add a date and a tag right in the title
inputs.emailError: Looks like there is a typo in the address

overlays.popoverText: Panels appear where you clicked and leave the same way.

dialogs.title: Delete project “Moving house”?
dialogs.text: The project’s tasks will go to the trash. You can restore them within 30 days.
dialogs.sheetText: On phones, dialogs become bottom sheets you can swipe away.

toasts.errorText: Could not save. We will check the connection and retry.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.text: The astronaut is waiting for your first task. Press N and a new star will light up.

effects.cursorHint: Desktop only. Can be turned off in settings.
effects.spotlightText: A soft light follows the pointer and shows where you are.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue your flight.
login.unconfirmedText: Open the email we sent when you signed up, or send it again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: One minute and your sky is ready.
register.usernameHint: 3–24 characters: Latin letters, digits and _. Friends will find you by it.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with letters and digits.

status.invalid: Latin letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter
status.error: Could not check — carry on, we will check on submit

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.text: We sent an email to {email}. Open it and press the button — and we will continue.
checkEmail.textNoEmail: We sent a confirmation email. Open it and press the button — and we will continue.
checkEmail.noEmail: No email? Look in Spam or send it again.
checkEmail.sent: A new email is on its way

confirm.successText: Welcome aboard! Let’s set up your ship.
confirm.emailChangedText: Sign in with your new address from now on.
confirm.expiredText: Links in emails work for one hour. Sign in and we will offer to send a new one.
confirm.invalidText: It may have been opened already. Try signing in or request a new email.
confirm.emailPartialText: The first confirmation is in. Open the email we sent to your other address and press the button there to finish the change.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentText: If an account with {email} exists, the email contains a link to set a new password. It works for one hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Pick a strong password — the meter will help.
reset.noSessionText: Request a new email — it takes a minute.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first — the message is in your inbox
errors.weakPassword: Password is too simple: at least 8 characters with letters and digits
errors.samePassword: The new password is the same as the old one
errors.emailRateLimit: Too many emails in a row. Try again in a few minutes
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again
errors.invalidUsername: Username does not fit: Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter
errors.linkExpired: The link has expired. Request a new one
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again
errors.passwordRules: At least 8 characters with letters and digits
errors.emailTaken: This email already belongs to another account

welcome.title: Welcome aboard, {name}
welcome.text: Let’s tune the ship for you — it takes less than a minute.
welcome.name: What should we call you

graphics.title: Graphics quality
graphics.text: We checked your device and suggest “{quality}”. You can change it any time in settings.
graphics.auto: We pick and adapt it while you work
graphics.ultra: Every effect, maximum particles and depth
graphics.high: Beautiful and smooth on most devices
graphics.low: Light effects — for older phones and saving battery

sound.title: Sound
sound.text: Short soft sounds confirm your actions. Space ambience is optional.

profile.title: Profile
profile.qrText: A friend points a phone camera at it and can send you a request.
profile.bioPlaceholder: A few words about your orbit

avatar.cropText: Drag and zoom to choose the frame.
avatar.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB — pick a smaller one
avatar.wrongType: Please choose an image: JPG, PNG or WebP

profile.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — select the ID and copy it by hand
profile.shareText: Add me as a friend on Veritas Tasks: {id}
profile.usernameHint: Latin letters, digits and _. You can change it up to 5 times a day.

account.emailChangeSent: We sent confirmations to the old and the new address. The email changes once confirmed.
account.reauthText: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it to change your password.
account.signOutAllText: Every device, including this one, will ask you to sign in again. Other devices disconnect within an hour.
account.signedOutAll: You signed out on all devices
account.deleteText: All tasks, projects, progress and files will be deleted forever. This cannot be undone.
account.deleted: Account deleted. Thank you for flying with us
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, letters and digits.
account.sessionsText: Lost a phone or signed in on someone else’s computer? Sign out everywhere.

appearance.cursorHint: Only on computers with a mouse.
appearance.motionHint: Animations become gentle fades. The system setting is always respected.
appearance.qualityHint: Affects 3D scenes and the background. Saved for this device.
appearance.accentHint: The colour of light in the interface. Saved to your account for every device.

sound.ambientHint: A quiet background on the landing page and the intro. Off by default.
sound.iosHint: On iPhone, sounds are silent while the mute switch is on.
sound.channelsHint: Interface — clicks and toggles; effects — completed tasks, levels and achievements.

language.languageHint: Our emails will arrive in this language too.
language.timezoneHint: Due dates, repeats and reminders follow it.

privacy.friendRequests: Who can send you friend requests
privacy.searchable: People can find me by username
privacy.searchableHint: If off, people can add you only by ID or QR code.
privacy.leaderboardHint: Friends will see your level and experience.
privacy.everyoneHint: Anyone who knows your username, ID or QR code can send a request.
privacy.friendsOfFriendsHint: Only people you share a friend with.
privacy.nobodyHint: No new requests arrive. You can still add people yourself.
